items.title: Maresca is 'perfect person' for Man City job - Dias
items.summary: Manchester City defender Ruben Dias speaks to BBC Sport's Kelly Somers about the changes at the club following Pep Guardiola's departure.

items.title: New Man City signings desperate to win - Dias
items.summary: Manchester City have brought in summer signings who are "desperate to win" and the whole squad is "buying into the idea" of new manager Enzo Maresca, says new captain Ruben Dias.
